payload.label: Turn audio into text
payload.description: Turns stored audio or video bytes into full text, word timelines, segment timelines, speaker labels, and transcript artifact records through a package-owned command-output-to-records script and the shared command-run capability.

options_contract.profile_ref: address of a content-media.evidence-work-profile record; profile data owns execution target, command policy, output policy, and proof gates
options_contract.output_options: open caller preferences such as word timelines or segment timelines; never contains process descriptors, provider paths, or command policy

timing_source_semantics.engine_token_timestamps: Both start and end parse from the provider token row; this identifies the timing source and does not assert forced alignment or accuracy.
timing_source_semantics.segment_uniform_estimate: No token rows were available; the segment duration was divided evenly across its text tokens.
timing_source_semantics.segment_bounds_fallback: At least one token boundary was unavailable or invalid; a segment boundary supplied the fallback span.

payload.source_fingerprint_contract: Stable source identity derived from source.artifact_ref integrity_hash, multihash, cas_address, content_hash, or sha256.
payload.large_artifact_contract: Full transcript artifacts, word timelines, segment timelines, and provider raw output are stored in output_artifact_refs when they exceed inline preview size.

payload.details_contract: optional machine-readable command/process details; never stores fabricated transcript content

payload.name: write-audio-transcription-record-from-command-run
payload.description: Write one canonical audio-transcription record emitted by the command run.

payload.name: submit-audio-transcription-request
payload.description: Write the canonical request, read the selected media evidence work profile, run its data-owned execution descriptor through compute.process, make package records from declared JSON output, and write accepted result/error records.

config.error: The existing transcript does not match this exact request and source revision.

output_contract.first_declared_output: application/json command output consumed by the package record-making script

config.error: Transcription finished without saving a matching transcript result.

payload.name: audio-master
payload.description: Master a voice track: highpass, two-pass loudnorm to target loudness, true-peak limiter, measurement-gated denoise. Emits the mastered file plus a before/after loudness report.

payload.name: auto-transcribe-recorded-media
payload.description: Hands-free lane: a newly recorded media fact submits itself for transcription through the same data-owned media evidence work profile as manual submit. Request id derives from the recorded file id, so re-firing the trigger re-uses one request instead of duplicating work.

payload._activation: is_active IS the auto-transcribe switch — flipping it is a data write, zero code. ON by default: recordings transcribe themselves.
